# Government Will Start Paying Down the Debt

The Treasury confirmed that Kunasai will begin repaying the principal of its debt to the Fund this year. The decision means tighter budgets for most ministries. Bond prices rose. Alexander Fontes said the government wanted to 'reduce the share of every tax that goes abroad before it reaches a school'.
